svg.title: S1 chatbot coverage
svg.desc: Evaluation coverage. (a) All 17 conversation categories, counted once per scenario/turn; 54 turns across 34 scenarios were each executed through JSON and SSE (108 executions). Labels indicate passed/evaluated turns in each transport. (b) Factual cases per endpoint: 8 endpoints had 2 cases, 26 had 3, 16 had 4 and 2 had 5, totaling 168 cases across 52 endpoints. Of these cases, 133 expected success and 35 expected no data. Endpoint coverage does not imply exhaustive entity, path or natural-language coverage.
